package.name: uav_groundstation
package.description:
The operator's window onto the aircraft: one web page served from the Jetson showing what is running, what the autopilot says, where the aircraft is relative to its geofence, and how the host is doing. Also carries ocs_client, the 2 Hz heartbeat to the Operator Control Station.
The one package allowed to KNOW ABOUT every other package - it names their nodes in order to launch them - while IMPORTING none of them. That is what keeps it off the dependency graph of the code it starts.
